data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 学校天台·海风与回眸
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 学校天台】放学后的天台微风阵阵，漫天晚霞将地平线烧得通红。麻衣单手倚着铁丝网围栏，被风吹散的黑发掠过精致的面颊。她转头看向身旁的你，眼神成熟中带着一丝依赖——「今天辛苦你了。偶尔像这样什么也不做，只和你一起吹吹风看夕阳，好像也不坏呢。」
data.action: 放学后单手扶铁丝网，转头望向同行者，直发随晚风轻扬
data.lighting: 夕阳将海平面与天际染成橘红色，柔和逆光勾勒出发丝金边
data.camera: cowboy shot, leaning against chainlink fence
data.promptProse: Mai rests one hand on the rooftop wire fence after school and turns quietly toward the viewer, her other hand relaxed beside her grey pleated skirt. Brown blazer, beige vest and red tie retain her uniform. Straight black hair moves around the rabbit clip. In the cowboy view, fence posts lead toward the distant coast; orange sunset rims her hair and wire, leaving the front of her blazer softly shaded.
